title: Correct unsafe mechanics.conditions relation semantics in spells and effects
description:
Finding source:
- Codex High finding: mechanics.conditions is not safe as deterministic effect semantics.
- Codex found 12 likely wrong relation: "applies" projections where source text is prevention, removal, immunity/protection, or gating instead.
- Concrete examples: branding-smite, calm-emotions, lesser-restoration, and protection-from-evil-and-good.
- ChatGPT confirmed branding-smite was already present before the latest erf5 changes: source says the target becomes visible if invisible and cannot become invisible, but mechanics records condition=invisible relation=applies.
- Fable independently confirmed in the committed pack: branding-smite marks invisible as applies (source: target cannot become invisible), calm-emotions marks charmed as applies (source: suppresses), lesser-restoration marks blinded as applies (source: ends a condition), protection-from-evil-and-good marks charmed as applies (source: protects against).

Why it matters:
- Deterministic tools may apply the opposite of the SRD effect.
- "Applies condition" must not be used for prevents/removes/protects-from/grants-advantage-against/gates-on/mentions.

Acceptance criteria:
- Audit every mechanics.conditions entry in spells and any shared effect parser output against source text.
- Replace unsafe relation values with a closed vocabulary that can express at least: inflicts, prevents, removes, suppresses, protectsFrom/immunizesAgainst, grantsAdvantageAgainst, excludes, gatesOn, mentions.
- Fix all 12 Codex-identified likely wrong cases plus any additional cases found.
- Add tests for branding-smite, calm-emotions, lesser-restoration, protection-from-evil-and-good, and at least one true condition-inflicting spell/effect to prevent overcorrection.
- Add a guard so prevention/removal/immunity phrases cannot be emitted as relation=applies.
- Document relation semantics for deterministic consumers.
notes: Implemented in PR #385 (branch eshyra-o9bd.18.3, awaiting review/merge). Shared classifier src/rules/conditionRelations.ts; vocabulary now applies/removes/prevents/suppresses/immune/advantage/disadvantage/exclusion/gates/mention; condition-relation-safety audit gate re-derives all 512 entries; 30 relation values fixed across 21 records (20 wrong applies incl. all Codex cases + 8 more, 10 mention upgrades); thaw note docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/thaw-notes/2026-07-02-o9bd-18-3-condition-relation-safety.md. Close on merge.
close_reason: Merged to main in PR #385 (merge commit 55f5f98). Reviewer non-blocking note recorded: the condition-relation-safety audit gate shares the classifier with the importer, so it is a drift/hand-edit guard, NOT an independent semantic oracle — semantic safety rests on the regression tests and the thaw note's full 512-entry manual audit. If future relation bugs surface, fix them with classifier regression tests (mechanicsProjections.test.ts / conditionRelations), not by relying on the gate.
